phrase.zh: 看清组成，才能重新构造。
phrase.en: Understand the structure, then build it anew.

visual.zh: 装着晶体的玻璃浅皿从右下越出画面，六边形金属环悬在上方，环与浅皿的刻线阴影落向左上。
visual.en: A shallow glass dish filled with crystals crops at the lower right. A six-sided metal loop hovers above it, with etched shadows from the loop and dish extending toward the upper left.

background.zh:
霍沃思因研究碳水化合物和维生素C，获得1937年诺贝尔化学奖的一半，另一半授予卡雷尔。他揭示糖分子的环状组织，并研究维生素C的结构与合成。画面用糖晶体上方的六边金属环和影子表达结构被看清；金属环只寓意糖的环状组织，不是维生素C的准确分子式、原子数量或实际实验模型。短句为原创。
1937年化学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：研究碳水化合物和维生素C
background.en:
Haworth received half the 1937 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for his investigations of carbohydrates and vitamin C; Karrer received the other half. He revealed ring-like organization in sugars and investigated vitamin C structure and synthesis. A six-sided metal loop and shadow above sugar-like crystals symbolize revealing structure. The loop refers qualitatively to cyclic sugars, not an exact vitamin C formula, atom count or laboratory model. The phrase is original.
1937 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: for his investigations on carbohydrates and vitamin C
